row.notes: Same component and local-player record lookup as 0x1436a5ce0. Returns slot ratio float +0x1a4 / float +0x1ac of slot*0x1c8 (slot valid when ptr +8 is set and both > 0). Fallbacks when the ratio is 0: for slot 0-2 the neighbour slots (averaged when both exist), then slot 3, then slot 4; for slot 3/4 the other one of the pair, then slot 2, then the average of slots 0 and 1. Result is clamped to 0.75..1.4, default 1.0. Context from caller: Sess_StrategySystem_Slot3_UpdateAll calls it for 0..4 and multiplies five per-compound floats (+0x98e0..+0x98f0 based) into strategy+0x1e8..+0x208, so the slot is a tyre compound index. Better context needed: the practice origin of the record is not shown by the code. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
